linkblockUsage:
Blocks links that aren't in the allowed-domains list.

Usage:

- `{{prefix}}linkblock on|off`
- `{{prefix}}linkblock allow|disallow <domain>`
- `{{prefix}}linkblock list|reset`

_Replace `<domain>` with the actual domain_
autobanToggled: Auto-ban is now {{status}} for this group.
autobanUsageAddRemove:
Use: `{{prefix}}autoban {{action}} numero|ddd|cc <value>`

_Replace `<value>` with the actual value_
autobanUsage:
Automatically removes anyone joining with a number, area code or country code on the list.

Usage:

- `{{prefix}}autoban on|off|status|list`
- `{{prefix}}autoban add numero|ddd|cc <value>`
- `{{prefix}}autoban remove numero|ddd|cc <value>`

_Replace `<value>` with the actual value_
muteUsage:
Usage: `{{prefix}}mute <time> [all] @member` (or reply)

_Time: 30s, 10m, 1h, 1d — max 30 days. Add `all` to mute across all community groups._

muteSuperAdminIn: They're a super admin in these groups, so I skipped them: {{groups}}

antispamUsage:
Automatically removes anyone sending too many messages within a few seconds.

Usage: `{{prefix}}antispam on|off|status`
antispamTriggered: Removed from the community for spamming.
cleanmsgUsage:
Deletes someone's most recent messages in the group.

Use: `{{prefix}}cleanmsg <number> @member` (or reply to one of their messages)

_Replace `<number>` with a value from 0 to {{max}}_
cleanmsgZero: Sure, but 0 means nothing gets deleted.
closeAgendaTimeout: Timed out, the schedule setup was cancelled. Start again with `{{prefix}}close agenda`.
closeAgendaAlreadyInProgress: You already have a schedule setup in progress. Answer the previous question or type "cancelar".
closeAgendaLimitReached: This group already has {{max}} schedules, the limit. Remove one with `{{prefix}}close agenda reset` before adding another.
closeAgendaChooseType:
Let's schedule the group's close/open (times are always in Brasília time). You can type "cancelar" at any point to back out.

How should it repeat?
1 - Daily
2 - Weekly
3 - Monthly
4 - Specific date (just once)
5 - Annual (repeats every year)
closeAgendaWeeklyDays: Pick the weekdays, comma-separated (seg, ter, qua, qui, sex, sab, dom).
closeAgendaWeeklyDaysInvalid: Couldn't read those days. Use seg, ter, qua, qui, sex, sab or dom, comma-separated.
closeAgendaMonthlyDays: Type the days of the month, comma-separated (e.g. 1, 15, 30).
closeAgendaMonthlyDaysInvalid: Couldn't read those days. Use numbers from 1 to 31, comma-separated.
closeAgendaMonthlySkipped: These months don't have all the chosen days, so they'll be skipped: {{months}}.
closeAgendaSpecificDate: Type the date (example: 31/10 or "31 de outubro").
closeAgendaSpecificDateInvalid: That date isn't valid. Try again, example: 31/10 or "31 de outubro".
closeAgendaCloseTime: Now pick the time I should close the group (e.g. 23:00).
closeAgendaCloseTimeInvalid: Invalid time. Use HH:mm format, e.g. 23:00.
closeAgendaOpenTime: Now the time I should open the group (e.g. 06:00).
closeAgendaOpenTimeInvalid: Invalid time. Use HH:mm format, e.g. 06:00.
closeAgendaProximityOpen: With these times the group will stay open for only {{minutes}} minute(s) before closing again. Are you sure? (sim or não)
closeAgendaProximityClosed: With these times the group will stay closed for only {{minutes}} minute(s) before opening again. Are you sure? (sim or não)
closeAgendaCommunityAsk: Want to apply this schedule to every group in the community? (sim or não)
closeAgendaCommunitySkipped: {{count}} community group(s) were already at the schedule limit and got skipped.
closeAgendaResetConfirm: This will delete every schedule in this group, are you sure? (sim or não)
closeAgendaResetConfirmCommunity: Some of these schedules are also applied to other groups in the community. Delete them there too? (sim or não)
